response.description:
Integrating
apps with SaaS and line-of-business systems today means writing custom API
client code, managing credentials, and handling retries, pagination, and
webhooks for every service. Connector
Namespace is a fully managed service providing pre-built
connectors to services like SharePoint, Salesforce, Outlook, and SAP. Each
connector exposes typed actions and event triggers through a shared connection
model, while the platform handles auth, credential rotation, polling, webhook
delivery, and remote MCP hosting.Key
features: 
 Managed connections: reusable,
     authenticated bindings with built-in credential storage and rotation 
 Strongly-typed SDKs for C#,
     Node.js, and Python, plus HTTP access  
 Managed connector MCP servers
     hosting: deploy connector-as-MCP-server so agents can invote them as
     tools with custom wrappers 
 Hosted MCP servers: deploy from a
     catalog of supported servers with managed dependencies,
     configuration, auth, and more 
 Flexible compute: use with
     Azure Functions, Container Apps, App Service, or your own infra 
 Enterprise security: VNet, private
     endpoints, RBAC, and Azure Monitor built in.  With
Connector Namespace, you integrate apps and AI agents through a consistent
model, reuse connections, go from connector to MCP server in minutes, and let
the platform handle auth and reliability so you ship faster with fewer moving
parts. Learn
more.
